_: The spell each class casts on itself before the first turn of every fight -- its passive -- and
the spell type ('Hechizos iniciales <clase>' in the client's own spell types) that gathers the
class's initial spells. The client's data links neither to a breed, so this is measured in the
class captures: the passive is the spell cast in every fight of the class and in no other's,
and for the classes with no fight captured it is the spell of that type carrying the class's
name. The other spells of the type are cast at fight start too, one for each spell of the same
name the character has -- the Tymador with Explobomba gets 25200 'Explobomba' at his grade of
it, with Explobomba Resiliente 24847 instead -- and that part is read off the names, not from
here. Order in the captures: those first, then the item attitudes, then the passive.
